cases.question: Tìm nhân viên có tên chứa MCP DQE Employee 1 bằng truy vấn HRM.
cases.verificationSql: SELECT display_name FROM employees WHERE company_id=$1 AND display_name ILIKE '%MCP DQE Employee 1%'
cases.sql: SELECT e.id AS "id", e.display_name AS "display_name", d.name AS "department_name", e.title AS "title", e.employment_status AS "employment_status", e.email AS "email" FROM employees e LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.company_id = e.company_id AND d.id = e.department_id WHERE e.company_id = $1 AND e.display_name ILIKE $2 ESCAPE '\' ORDER BY e.id ASC LIMIT $3 OFFSET $4
